ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - VFE Factory Pack
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description:
Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory in IsoRim's 3D view and on IsoRimZ floors.
- 3D conveyor belts: straight belts, turns, mergers, splitters, filters, refuelling ports and underground belts - 3D factory hoppers that show input and output like VFE's - Items ride on the belts, with their stack counts and flow arrows on top - With IsoRimZ: drill platforms stay on the ground; autofarmers work only on their own floor
Needs the latest IsoRim Waylith; older versions load without the conveyor models.
让 Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory 在 IsoRim 的 3D 视角和 IsoRimZ 的楼层上正常工作。
- 3D 传送带：直带、转弯、合流、分流、过滤器、加料口和地下传送带 - 3D 工厂料斗，和 VFE 一样显示输入和输出 - 物品在传送带上移动，数量标签和流向箭头显示在上方 - 配合 IsoRimZ：自动钻井平台只能建在地面；自动农场只在自己所在的楼层工作
需要最新版 IsoRim Waylith；版本较旧时也能加载，只是没有传送带模型。
